wiki.title: Kenneth Weyler
wiki.extract: Kenneth Weyler (born October 18, 1941) is an American politician in the state of New Hampshire. He is a member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives, sitting as a Republican from the Rockingham 13 district, having been first elected in 2010. He previously served from 1990 to 2008. He currently serves as Chair of the House Finance Committee.
